A man was taken into custody after a standoff with deputies in Zapata County on Saturday, November 7, according to KGNS.

Deputies with the Zapata County Sheriff's Office responded to reports of a man acting erratically, KGNS reported. The man allegedly barricaded himself inside a travel trailer, and deputies called in the Sheriff's Office Special Response Team, with help from several other agencies.

After a lengthy standoff, the man was taken into custody without further escalation, according to KGNS. No injuries were reported.

The man was identified as Hector Baldomero Esquivel. He was charged with three counts of terroristic threat against a peace officer, false report to induce an emergency response, and resisting arrest. The charges are allegations, and he is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Source: KGNS, November 8, 2026.

title: Man taken into custody after standoff with deputies in Zapata County
